Chi_Search_Description: How Chi answers questions from what was actually said in your conversations. Chi only ever searches conversations you are in, inside your own firm.
Chi_Search_Embeddings_Enabled_Descriptio: Let Chi answer questions by meaning rather than by matching words, so "what did we decide about the deposition date?" finds the exchange even when nobody used those words. Requires an embedding provider below. Leave this off and Chi still answers from your messages using keyword search.
Chi_Search_Embeddings_Base_URL_Descripti: The base URL of any OpenAI-compatible embeddings API, without a trailing slash — for example https://api.openai.com/v1, or http://localhost:11434/v1 for a model running on this server. Message text is sent to this endpoint, so a local endpoint keeps it on your own machine.
Chi_Search_Embeddings_API_Key_Descriptio: The key for the endpoint above. Leave blank for a local provider that does not require one.
Chi_Search_Embeddings_Model_Description: The model that turns passages into vectors, for example text-embedding-3-small. Changing the model makes everything already indexed unusable — rebuild the index afterwards.
Chi_Search_Embeddings_Dimensions_Descrip: Leave at 0 to use whatever the model returns. Set a smaller number only if your provider supports shortening vectors; changing it invalidates everything already indexed.
Chi_Search_Include_Shared_Rooms_Descript: Also search conversations that belong to no single firm — workspace-wide channels and rooms shared between firms. People still only ever see conversations they are a member of. Off by default so results stay strictly inside one firm.
Chi_Search_No_Scope: There are no conversations in scope for you to search yet.
Chi_Search_Keyword_Fallback_Notice: Semantic search is not set up on this workspace, so these are keyword matches.
Chi_Search_Index_Empty: Nothing is indexed yet. An admin can build the index from Chi.
